text: 深交所本周共对114起证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，涉及盘中拉抬打压、虚假申报等异常交易情形；共对6起上市公司重大事项进行核查，并上报证监会1起涉嫌违法违规案件线索。
text_en: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange this week took self-regulatory measures against 114 cases of abnormal securities trading, involving abnormal trading situations such as intraday price ramping and suppression and false declarations; it conducted verifications of 6 major matters of listed companies and reported 1 clue involving suspected violations of laws and regulations to the CSRC.
